mechanism.deployed: successful deploy receipt whose subject_ref points to that tested artifact ref
mechanism.production_verified: successful uptime receipt whose subject_ref points to that deployment ref
mechanism.composition: one coherent successful receipt chain only
mechanism.receipt_identity: deterministic evidence graph and supporting-chain fingerprints

does_not_own: Vercel affiliation, adoption, or production deployment
